title: The market previewExitFor override is sealed against subclassing (override without virtual)
description: ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy declares previewExitFor as external view override at :162-166, where the deliberate base at AYieldStrategy.sol:571-577 is external view virtual override. Every other overridable hook on the contract (_disposeShares, _positionValue, getTotalShares) remains reachable; this one is the exception.
impact: A forked variant cannot patch previewExitFor. That matters in a repo with a demonstrated forked-variant habit (NFTStakerPriceScaled, StableStakerV1/V2) and five defects (L-18..L-22) a subclass would want to patch.
attackPath: A future forked variant needs to correct one of L-18..L-22 in its own subclass.
previewExitFor is sealed, so the override cannot be taken.
The variant must fork the whole contract instead.
recommendation: One word: add virtual to the market override's declaration.
invalidHeadingTested: 'Unused view functions (QA at best)' does NOT apply — the claim is not 'a view is unused', it is that the OVERRIDE IS SEALED. That is a statement about the inheritance surface and would be equally true of a heavily-used function.
escalationTrigger: A forked variant actually being created that needs to patch previewExitFor and cannot => Low.
